name: What common issues should I expect when renovating an older home?

mainEntity.name: What common issues should I expect when renovating an older home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Renovating an older home often uncovers hidden issues such as outdated electrical wiring, plumbing systems, and HVAC. You might also encounter structural concerns, lead-based paint, asbestos, or uninsulated walls. These discoveries are normal and require a general contractor experienced in addressing historical building practices while adhering to current safety and building codes. Budgeting for contingencies is crucial to handle these unexpected challenges efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expect potential issues like outdated wiring, plumbing, HVAC, or structural concerns. An experienced contractor can navigate these common challenges.
